step: 6.1.3 inline memory review and spoken decision
scope: Save/Dismiss moved outside Personalization to separate group right of four conversation controls; responsive wrap
Normal model reply asks permission in selected language/style; no second TTS or fixed nickname
Later spoken/text response uses memory.read then memory.decide through existing registry/policy/TaskManager and same PersonalMemory owner
guards: No same-turn proposal self-approval even after reread
Fresh actual pending ID and nonempty actual user input required
Replaced/expired ID rejected; changed snapshot clears pending on read
Replay writes once; late UI approval after voice decision fails safely
Verified decided_id clears only matching UI candidate, including completed decision before Stop
Unknown/readback/Stop rules preserved; no new save feedback loop
browser_layout: 1280x800 review group in viewport, visible separator
test_adjustments: Old browser assertion failed at 1280px because narrow layout intentionally wraps; right-side desktop assertion moved to 1920px and 1280px bounds/separator asserted separately. No application behavior was weakened.
not_tested: real-model interpretation of ambiguous approval, unrelated speech or extracting facts
limits: Natural-language consent remains a model semantic decision; structural gates cannot prove every ambiguous utterance is consent
One pending candidate in RAM; replacement invalidates prior ID and restart drops candidate
Task journal may retain proposed facts/source even after profile memory deletion
